name: BiscottiCMP
summary: Biscotti CMP iOS SDK — TCF 2.4 prerelease published for IAB Europe mobile registration review.
description:
Biscotti CMP iOS SDK release candidate: native consent dialog, consent-gated
SDK initialisation, App Tracking Transparency coordination, offline queueing
and consent sync.

This is a prerelease published on CocoaPods trunk so that reviewers and
integrators can install the exact build the TCF 2.4 Native App (Mobile)
registration evidence was captured from. Pin it explicitly
(`pod 'BiscottiCMP', '2.0.0-rc.5'`); unversioned resolution keeps the 1.x
stable line until IAB Europe grants the mobile registration and 2.0.0 is cut.
